findings.current: Everything alive is born into a struggle.
findings.defect: The source says every living thing is bestowed a destiny of struggle at birth. “Born into a struggle” drops the explicit sense of an assigned fate.
findings.rationale: 탄생과 동시에 투쟁의 운명을 부여받는다 explicitly describes receiving the fate of struggle at the moment of birth; the accepted baseline preserved that meaning.
findings.replacement: Everything alive is born with a destiny of struggle.

findings.current: By the time I spotted the archers and their dark bows through the thinning ranks of fanatics, it was too late.
findings.defect: The source specifies shortbows; “bows” omits that physical detail.
findings.rationale: 묵색의 단궁 specifies dark-colored shortbows, not bows generally.
findings.replacement: By the time I spotted the archers and their dark shortbows through the thinning ranks of fanatics, it was too late.

summary: Two minor omissions weaken source-specific meaning and physical detail.
